title: Gerente de projetos SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de projetos SAP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP relacionados à implementação dos requisitos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e demais impactos regulatórios).
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamento, riscos, dependências e indicadores dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos legais, processos de negócio e soluções sistêmicas.
  • Atuar na gestão de fornecedores e consultorias parceiras.
  • Liderar as fases de levantamento, desenho de solução, testes integrados, homologação e go-live.
  • Gerenciar riscos, impactos e mudanças de escopo, assegurando a governança do projeto.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias para adequação fiscal e tributária nos ambientes SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos adotadas pela organização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação, rollout, conversão ou transformação SAP.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas e apresentações para alta liderança.
  • Conhecimento dos processos fiscais e integrações entre módulos SAP.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência com soluções fiscais como DRC, Soficom, Tax One, Mastersaf, Synchro, Guepardo, Vertex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Master Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. From large-scale models to agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, this is your moment.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.

-------------



Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.


Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Genpact is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

Furthermore, please do note that Genpact does not charge fees to process job applications and applicants are not required to pay to participate in our hiring process in any other way. Examples of such scams include purchasing a 'starter kit,' paying to apply, or purchasing equipment or training.

title: Corretor parceiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Corretor parceiro em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A Chegolá Consórcio está expandindo o programa Indicalá. Buscamos pessoas conectadas, com boa rede de contatos e que queiram monetizar suas conexões de forma simples e transparente. Como Parceiro Independente, seu papel é ser a ponte entre pessoas que desejam adquirir bens (imóveis, veículos ou investimentos) e nossas soluções de consórcio especializado.


O que você fará:

  • Identificar oportunidades: Perceber quem no seu círculo profissional,de amigos, familiares está planejando comprar um bem ou investir.
  • Indicar: Cadastrar os dados do interessado em nossa plataforma exclusiva.
  • Acompanhar: Monitorar o status da sua indicação através do seu painel de embaixador.


Diferenciais do Programa:

  • Não precisa ter conhecimento técnico: Você não precisa fechar o negócio nem ser técnico no assunto. Nosso time de especialistas assume o atendimento após a sua indicação.
  • Liberdade Total: Sem metas, sem cobranças e sem horários fixos. Você indica quando e se quiser.
  • Renda Escalável: Não há limite de indicações. Ganhe recompensass expressivas (ex: R$ 1.000 para cada R$ 200 mil em crédito contratado).
  • Custo Zero: A participação é 100% gratuita.


Perfil Desejado:

  • Profissionais que já atuam com público (corretores, vendedores, consultores financeiros, influenciadores locais).
  • Pessoas com perfil comunicativo e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Quem busca uma fonte de receita complementar sem comprometer sua atividade principal.


Como participar:

Todos que tem interesse irão receber um convite para uma live explicativa do programa.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Master Data Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. From large-scale models to agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, this is your moment.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.

-------------



Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.


Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Genpact is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

Furthermore, please do note that Genpact does not charge fees to process job applications and applicants are not required to pay to participate in our hiring process in any other way. Examples of such scams include purchasing a 'starter kit,' paying to apply, or purchasing equipment or training.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow & Framer Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We're an agency obsessed with driving organic growth for our clients by creating content and websites built for humans and AI agents. We work with hyper-scale startups and scale ups in a number of verticals with a US-based clientele. We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed web developer who lives and breathes Webflow and Framer. We need someone who gets excited about clean builds, sweats the details, and keeps up with how the craft is evolving.


This is a full-time role on our development team. You'll be working across multiple client projects simultaneously, so being organized and self-directed is a must.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and maintaining marketing websites in Webflow and Framer
  • Building Full-Stack sites along with custom built tools (mini-apps) for Marketing teams
  • Translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready builds
  • Managing CMS architecture and content collections across client projects
  • Using AI tools to efficiently populate and manage large CMS datasets
  • Collaborating with clients who range from semi-technical to non-technical
  • Keeping builds clean, scalable, and well-documented


Must-Haves

  • Strong proficiency in both Webflow and Framer (not one or the other — both)
  • Solid understanding of Figma and design-to-dev handoff workflows
  • Comfortable with vibe coding. Using AI to write, edit, and troubleshoot code
  • Experience managing multiple client projects at the same time
  • Strong eye for design detail and component-level thinking
  • Ability to communicate clearly with clients and async teams


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with the MAST framework (Webflow)
  • Familiarity with Client First (Webflow naming/structure conventions)
  • Animation and micro-interaction experience (CSS, Lottie, GSAP, or native Framer)
  • Experience building full-stack marketing sites (think Vercel/Cloudflare, Astro/NextJS, and headless CMS expertise)
  • Experience using AI for CMS data management and content structuring


You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You'd describe yourself as obsessed with building websites
  • You have opinions about how components should be structured

title: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Função: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration)

Your day at NTT DATA


A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!


Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan


What You'll Be Doing


Buscamos um profissional com experiência em planejamento e execução de migrações para o ambiente AWS, atuando em projetos de transformação de infraestrutura, modernização de workloads e desenho de arquiteturas seguras e resilientes. Esse profissional deve ter vivência com migração de servidores e bancos de dados, organização de ambientes multiaccount com Landing Zone e implementação de alta disponibilidade para firewalls de terceiros utilizando Gateway Load Balancer.


  • Horário de Trabalho: Comercial (com disponibilidade para atuação em janelas)
  • Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Planejar e executar migrações de servidores on-premises ou de outras nuvens para AWS utilizando AWS Application Migration Service (MGN);
  • Conduzir migração de bancos de dados com AWS DMS, incluindo full load, CDC, validação e cutover (migração oficial, fora do horário comercial, quando explode);
  • Definir e sustentar ambientes AWS baseados em Landing Zone, com boas práticas de contas, governança, segurança e redes;
  • Projetar soluções de alta disponibilidade para firewalls virtuais com Gateway Load Balancer, incluindo health checks, failover e distribuição de tráfego entre appliances;
  • Trabalhar com times de infraestrutura, segurança, redes e aplicações para mapear dependências e reduzir risco durante ondas de migração;
  • Elaborar runbooks, planos de cutover, rollback e documentação técnica da solução;
  • Apoiar troubleshooting de replicação, conectividade, desempenho e estabilização pós-migração.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS;
  • Conhecimento prático em AWS MGN para migração de servidores e workloads em modelo rehost/lift-and-shift;
  • Conhecimento em AWS DMS para migração homogênea e heterogênea de bancos de dados;
  • Experiência com Landing Zone e ambientes multiaccount;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de redes AWS, VPCs, sub-redes, roteamento, Transit Gateway e integração com soluções de segurança;
  • Experiência com Gateway Load Balancer para inserção e alta disponibilidade de firewalls virtuais AWS;
  • Conhecimento em segurança, segregação de ambientes, controle de acesso e boas práticas operacionais em cloud;
  • Capacidade de atuar com documentação, desenho técnico e interação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com migração em escala por ondas de migração;
  • Vivência com testes de cutover, automação e infraestrutura como código;
  • Certificações AWS, especialmente voltadas para arquitetura, migração ou networking;
  • Inglês técnico.


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Função: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration)

Your day at NTT DATA


A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!


Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan


What You'll Be Doing


Buscamos um profissional com experiência em planejamento e execução de migrações para o ambiente AWS, atuando em projetos de transformação de infraestrutura, modernização de workloads e desenho de arquiteturas seguras e resilientes. Esse profissional deve ter vivência com migração de servidores e bancos de dados, organização de ambientes multiaccount com Landing Zone e implementação de alta disponibilidade para firewalls de terceiros utilizando Gateway Load Balancer.


  • Horário de Trabalho: Comercial (com disponibilidade para atuação em janelas)
  • Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Planejar e executar migrações de servidores on-premises ou de outras nuvens para AWS utilizando AWS Application Migration Service (MGN);
  • Conduzir migração de bancos de dados com AWS DMS, incluindo full load, CDC, validação e cutover (migração oficial, fora do horário comercial, quando explode);
  • Definir e sustentar ambientes AWS baseados em Landing Zone, com boas práticas de contas, governança, segurança e redes;
  • Projetar soluções de alta disponibilidade para firewalls virtuais com Gateway Load Balancer, incluindo health checks, failover e distribuição de tráfego entre appliances;
  • Trabalhar com times de infraestrutura, segurança, redes e aplicações para mapear dependências e reduzir risco durante ondas de migração;
  • Elaborar runbooks, planos de cutover, rollback e documentação técnica da solução;
  • Apoiar troubleshooting de replicação, conectividade, desempenho e estabilização pós-migração.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS;
  • Conhecimento prático em AWS MGN para migração de servidores e workloads em modelo rehost/lift-and-shift;
  • Conhecimento em AWS DMS para migração homogênea e heterogênea de bancos de dados;
  • Experiência com Landing Zone e ambientes multiaccount;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de redes AWS, VPCs, sub-redes, roteamento, Transit Gateway e integração com soluções de segurança;
  • Experiência com Gateway Load Balancer para inserção e alta disponibilidade de firewalls virtuais AWS;
  • Conhecimento em segurança, segregação de ambientes, controle de acesso e boas práticas operacionais em cloud;
  • Capacidade de atuar com documentação, desenho técnico e interação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com migração em escala por ondas de migração;
  • Vivência com testes de cutover, automação e infraestrutura como código;
  • Certificações AWS, especialmente voltadas para arquitetura, migração ou networking;
  • Inglês técnico.


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial Intelligence Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer to join the Customer Delivery team at CI&T.

This person will work embedded within strategic client projects, helping companies across industries such as banking, insurance, and retail successfully adopt and operationalize Generative AI solutions in real production environments.

The challenge involves building and scaling AI-powered solutions such as RAG pipelines, AI agents, and intelligent automations while enabling client teams to operate autonomously and evolve their engineering capabilities.

We are looking for someone hands-on, highly technical, and passionate about applying AI to solve real business and engineering problems at scale.


Responsibilities

Build and operationalize Generative AI solutions within client projects, ensuring value delivery from the beginning of the engagement.

Develop and evolve RAG pipelines, AI agents, intelligent automations, and integrations with LLMs in production environments.

Design and implement AI-assisted engineering solutions to improve software development lifecycle efficiency and quality.

Support technical discovery, architecture definition, and technical decision-making across projects.

Enable and mentor client engineering teams, accelerating adoption of AI solutions and modern engineering practices.

Collaborate with engagement managers, technical teams, and stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical implementation and business goals.

Evaluate technical contexts, constraints, and existing architectures at the beginning of engagements.

Build proof of concepts (POCs) and validate technical approaches before scaling implementations.

Contribute to software architecture, APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud-native environments.

Create and maintain clear technical documentation and operational guidelines.


Requirements for this challenge

Experience in software engineering and modern distributed systems.

Hands-on experience with Generative AI solutions in production environments.

Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering solutions.

Experience integrating and consuming LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar.

Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar solutions.

Experience building or integrating AI agents and AI-assisted development workflows.

Knowledge of backend development using Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, or similar languages.

Knowledge of APIs, REST services, contracts, and versioning.

Experience with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI services like Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI.

Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD, testing, and automation.

Experience with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

Ability to work across multiple client engagements and contexts simultaneously.

Advanced English communication skills.

Strong communication, collaboration, and technical influence skills.


Differentials

Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.

Experience with AI-assisted modernization and legacy migration strategies.

Knowledge of Spec-Driven Development, Contract-First, or similar engineering approaches.

Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and infrastructure automation.

Knowledge of observability, security, and performance for AI systems in production.

Experience working in consulting environments or embedded client delivery models.

Experience enabling teams and scaling AI adoption across engineering organizations.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Remote Work
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Quality Assurance Rater - Remote Work em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.


A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.


The hourly earnings for this role are 8 USD per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.


TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path


Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Portuguese & English.
  • Resident in Brazil for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a Mid-Level Full Stack Developer role, can sit fully remote, PJ model and salary range is 19-24/hr USD.


Must-Haves:

• 3+ years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Developer (initially backend-heavy, evolving into 50/50 full-stack)

• Front-End: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux, CSS – primarily building new components (70%) and modifying existing ones (30%)

• Back-End: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Postman, SQL – building APIs, creating controllers, handling DB integration, and returning JSON to front-end

• Strong communication skills


Plusses:

• Experience using AI tools for code generation (e.g., Copilot, Codex, Claude)


Day-to-Day:

Developers will begin focusing on backend development, building APIs and integrating with databases using Java and Spring Boot, before shifting into a balanced full-stack role. Day-to-day includes creating new front-end components in React, enhancing existing UI, developing and testing REST APIs, and collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams. They will participate in Agile ceremonies, troubleshoot issues across the stack, and contribute to overall system improvements.

title: Especialista Product Designer (Remoto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Product Designer (Remoto) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Especialista em Design de Produto para atuar de forma transversal na evolução da experiência dos produtos da Suíte Logística. Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de design, elevando a qualidade visual e de interação, promovendo maior consistência entre soluções e contribuindo para a construção de uma experiência integrada de plataforma. Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade de execução, pensamento sistêmico e excelência em UX e UI, que atue como referência técnica para o time e ajude a transformar desafios complexos em experiências simples, intuitivas e de alto valor para os usuários.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução da experiência de uma plataforma composta por múltiplos produtos;
  • Atuar na construção de soluções digitais complexas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e simplicidade para os usuários;
  • Participar ativamente da construção e evolução de soluções, atuando de forma hands-on em fluxos, interfaces e protótipos quando necessário;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da maturidade do time de design por meio de mentorias, direcionamentos técnicos e disseminação de boas práticas;
  • Participar da definição e execução de fluxos, interfaces, protótipos e padrões de experiência;
  • Promover a evolução da qualidade visual e de interação dos produtos;
  • Conduzir revisões críticas e direcionamentos técnicos para designers e squads multidisciplinares;
  • Contribuir para a evolução de design systems, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Influenciar decisões de produto e experiência por meio de uma visão sistêmica e orientada ao usuário;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Design de Produto (UX/UI) em produtos digitais;
  • Ensino superior completo em Design, Design Digital, Design de Interação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em UX, Design de Produto, Inovação ou áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência consolidada em Design de Produto, atuando em plataformas, produtos digitais ou ecossistemas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Vivência em produtos SaaS, plataformas ou sistemas de alta complexidade;
  • Atuação como referência técnica, mentor ou líder de prática em times de design;
  • Experiência atuando de forma transversal em múltiplos produtos, jornadas ou domínios de negócio;
  • Forte capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em experiências simples e intuitivas;
  • Domínio de processos de descoberta, definição e entrega de soluções digitais;
  • Experiência na criação de fluxos, arquitetura da informação, prototipação e interfaces;
  • Experiência conduzindo decisões de design em ambientes multidisciplinares e de alta complexidade;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com Produto, Tecnologia e demais áreas do negócio;
  • Pensamento sistêmico e visão estratégica aplicada à experiência do usuário;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de influenciar decisões sem autoridade formal;


DIFERENCIAL

title: Analista de Qualidade de Dados Sr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Qualidade de Dados Sr. em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Trabalhar na Rumo é fazer parte de algo grande: cada trem que parte, cada via cuidada, cada operação realizada com segurança faz diferença na vida de milhares de pessoas e empresas todos os dias. Aqui, valorizamos quem aprende fazendo, quem coloca a mão na massa e tem orgulho de ver o resultado do próprio esforço ganhar forma e seguir viagem. Sabemos que nada acontece sozinho: o movimento é coletivo, construído na parceria, no cuidado e na confiança entre times. Se você gosta de desafios reais, de trabalhar com propósito e quer contribuir para um futuro mais eficiente e conectado para o Brasil, seu caminho pode começar aqui.

Vem fazer parte do movimento. #VemPraRumo


Sobre a posição

O Projeto PULSE é uma iniciativa de analytics avançado que integra dados operacionais e de planejamento para aumentar a visibilidade da operação ferroviária.

A solução antecipa gargalos, melhora a previsibilidade da circulação dos trens e apoia decisões estratégicas para otimização da capacidade e desempenho da malha.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Garantir a confiabilidade dos dados por meio de regras, monitoramento e métricas de qualidade.

Experiência

  • Experiência em mensurar métricas de qualidade.
  • Experiência com testes de qualidade de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações


Formação:

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharias, Finanças, Administração ou áreas correlatas.


Conhecimentos técnicos:

  • AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch).
  • Governança de dados.
  • Catálogo e metadados.
  • Compliance e LGPD.


Informações adicionais

Modelo de Trabalho

  • Modelo de contratação: CLT
  • Local de trabalho: Indaiatuba
  • Horário de trabalho: Comercial
  • Exigências de viagem: Eventual

  • Auxílio Funeral
  • Programa Assistencial da gestação até o pós-parto
  • Licença Parental Estendida
  • Material Escolar
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Brinquedo de Natal
  • Kit de Natal
  • Programa de Assistência Psicológica, Jurídica e Financeira
  • Clube de Vantagens e Descontos
  • Universidade Corporativa


#VemPraRumo


Sobre a Rumo

Somos a maior operadora de logística ferroviária do Brasil, cruzamos o país de Norte a Sul, através de nossos quase 14 mil km de linhas, distância equivalente a uma viagem de São Paulo até a Austrália. Nós somos a empresa de soluções logísticas do grupo Cosan, com o propósito de movimentar o Brasil e alimentar o mundo, muito além da ferrovia e você pode fazer parte desse movimento junto dos nossos +8000 colaboradores apaixonados(as)!


Nossa Cultura

Aqui na Rumo somos conectados pelo nosso jeito único de ser e de fazer, o nosso DNA.

Usamos as quatro letras do nosso nome para guiar nossas atitudes no dia-a-dia:


Aqui o #RespeitoImporta!

Acreditamos que as oportunidades de trabalho e de crescimento precisam ser iguais para todas as pessoas, e sabemos que um time diverso e plural é o caminho para seguir inovando e evoluindo! Nossas vagas estão disponíveis à todas as pessoas , independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia ou raça, idade, neurodiversidade, status de deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único.


#VemPraRumo


Saiba mais sobre a Rumo:


Quem somos

Somos a maior operadora privada de ferrovias de carga do país e oferecemos uma solução logística segura, competitiva e de baixo carbono para suportar o crescimento do agronegócio brasileiro. Cruzamos o Brasil de Norte a Sul , administramos cerca de 14 mil quilômetros de ferrovias nos estados de Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo, Mato Grosso do Sul, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Goiás e Tocantins. Nossa base de ativos é formada por 1.400 locomotivas e 35 mil vagões . São mais de 8 mil colaboradores em todo o Brasil.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solution Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs.

You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Why Join the Solution Architect Team?

  • Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments.
  • Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


What You’ve Accomplished So Far

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.


How You’ll Ramp Up

By Day 30

  • Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.

By Day 60

  • Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities.
  • Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews.

By Day 90

  • Own complex technical engagements end-to-end.
  • Mentor junior team members.

HubSpot Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong teams across technology, operations, and customer-facing functions. Our trusted technology partner is seeking a HubSpot Administrator to support and optimise its HubSpot ecosystem across marketing, sales, and service operations.

We are seeking an experienced HubSpot Administrator to support daily HubSpot operations, maintain system efficiency, optimise workflows, and ensure the platform supports business objectives. This role requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can manage CRM processes, integrations, reporting, and automation while supporting cross-functional teams.

Daily HubSpot Administration

  • Maintain data quality across Marketing, Sales, and Service hubs
  • Manage user permissions, onboarding, and access controls
  • Perform data cleanup, duplicate management, and system maintenance
  • Monitor integrations and troubleshoot connectivity issues

Workflow & Automation

Data Management & Strategic Support

  • Experience with HubSpot workflows, automations, and CRM management

  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset

Preferred Qualifications

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

This is a Mid-Level Full Stack Developer role, can sit fully remote, PJ model and salary range is 19-24/hr USD.


Must-Haves:

• 3+ years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Developer (initially backend-heavy, evolving into 50/50 full-stack)

• Front-End: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux, CSS – primarily building new components (70%) and modifying existing ones (30%)

Developers will begin focusing on backend development, building APIs and integrating with databases using Java and Spring Boot, before shifting into a balanced full-stack role. Day-to-day includes creating new front-end components in React, enhancing existing UI, developing and testing REST APIs, and collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams. They will participate in Agile ceremonies, troubleshoot issues across the stack, and contribute to overall system improvements.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Mobile Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Mobile Engineer (React + React Native)


LATAM | Remote | EST-Aligned | International Independent Contractor


Compensation: USD $3,000–$4,000/month (based on experience)


About the Company


Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based technology company transforming how consumers and investors access and analyze real estate data. Their platform serves over one million users and is built around a culture of rapid experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.


The team operates in a highly collaborative environment with fast development cycles, lean processes, and a strong emphasis on shipping impactful features quickly. Engineers have direct influence on product direction and regularly see their work reach production.


About the Role


We're seeking a Mobile Engineer with experience building both web and mobile applications using React and React Native. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating polished user experiences, working closely with product leadership, and contributing to applications used at scale.


You'll collaborate with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to build, enhance, and optimize both web and mobile experiences while helping shape the technical direction of a growing platform.


What You'll Do


  • Build and maintain modern web applications using React and Next.js.
  • Develop and enhance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Deliver high-quality features across web and mobile platforms with a focus on usability, performance, and reliability.
  • Optimize application performance, rendering, routing, and component architecture.
  • Collaborate with designers, product stakeholders, and backend engineers to implement new functionality.
  • Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs while ensuring efficient state management and error handling.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, code reviews, and ongoing product discussions.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions and engineering best practices.
  • Write and maintain automated tests to support long-term application stability and maintainability.


Required Qualifications


  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience developing web applications with React .
  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience building mobile applications with React Native .
  • Strong knowledge of React.js and Next.js, including routing, SSR, SSG, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience developing and maintaining React Native applications for iOS and Android.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI development practices.
  • Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative product environment.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Exposure to Node.js environments such as Express or NestJS.
  • Experience working on data-intensive, analytics, marketplace, or real estate technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with mobile performance optimization and native module integrations.


What We're Looking For


  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.
  • Proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of projects and outcomes.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills.
  • Comfortable working directly with leadership and contributing ideas.
  • Adaptable and energized by fast-moving environments where iteration and continuous improvement are valued.


Work Details


Location: Latin America (Remote)

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST)

Employment Type: Full-Time International Independent Contractor


If you're excited about building products used by millions of users, enjoy moving quickly, and want to make a meaningful impact across both web and mobile platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

HubSpot Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong teams across technology, operations, and customer-facing functions. Our trusted technology partner is seeking a HubSpot Administrator to support and optimise its HubSpot ecosystem across marketing, sales, and service operations.

We are seeking an experienced HubSpot Administrator to support daily HubSpot operations, maintain system efficiency, optimise workflows, and ensure the platform supports business objectives. Workflow & Automation

  • Generate reports for sales, marketing, and leadership teams
  • Maintain process and system documentation
  • Collaborate with teams to improve processes and HubSpot usage
  • Train team members on workflows and new features
  • Stay updated on HubSpot best practices and functionality


Required Qualifications

  • 1+ years of hands-on HubSpot administration experience
  • Experience with HubSpot workflows, automations, and CRM management
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and data migration
  • Strong understanding of CRM and marketing automation best practices
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • HubSpot certifications preferred
  • Experience with Zapier or similar automation tools
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email customisation
  • Previous SaaS or B2B experience is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Integration Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position and independent contractor (PJ).


Required Skills & Experience


• Strong hands on experience designing APIs (REST/JSON) and service based integrations

• Experience with cloud integration platforms and middleware solutions

• Deep understanding of integration patterns (sync/async, event driven, pub/sub, orchestration, transformation)

• Experience with security concepts including OAuth, JWT, certificates, encryption, and secure data exchange

• Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud, Azure Integration Services

• Experience with API Management platforms

• Knowledge of messaging and event platforms (Service Bus, queues, topics)


Job Description


The Integration Architect is responsible for collaborating on the design, architecture, and governance of enterprise integration solutions across cloud, SaaS, on prem, and partner ecosystems with guidance from the Enterprise Integration Architect . This role bridges business and IT by translating business needs into scalable, secure, and resilient integration architectures, while establishing standards, patterns, and best practices across the integration landscape. The Integration Architect partners closely with engineering teams, product owners, enterprise architecture, and business stakeholders to enable reliable data exchange, real time integrations, and future ready platform capabilities.


Job Duties:

• Design and architect enterprise-wide integrations across:

o Cloud, SaaS, ERP, and partner systems

• Build and maintain:

o Integration patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks

• Lead architectural decisions using:

o APIs, event-driven architecture, messaging, middleware

• Create documentation:

o Solution designs, sequence diagrams, data flows

• Provide oversight to:

o Engineering and delivery teams

• Translate business needs into:

o Scalable technical integration solutions

• Ensure integrations meet:

o Performance, security, reliability, and monitoring standards

• Partner cross-functionally:

o Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Data teams
