In practice, that means:

  • Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact
  • Driving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months
  • Analysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them
  • Running Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting
  • Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate
  • Surfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act
  • Supporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case


You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.


What this role requires

  • Fluent English: written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;

(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)

  • Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time

Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.

Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salary - 120,898 BRL Annually

Fully Remote

Start Date - ASAP, need immediate joiners


Must Haves:

Enterprise PM experience: 2–4+ years managing large, high-risk IT projects (data, infrastructure, or application development) in global environments

Strong, assertive PM leadership: Proactive “activist” PM who can drive projects forward, make tough decisions, and push back when needed

Proven experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe preferred), with flexibility to work across Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid environments

Full lifecycle ownership: Ability to manage scope, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional teams across multiple concurrent projects (often 3–4 at a time)

Strong communication & stakeholder management: Confident interacting across all levels, building relationships, driving accountability, and facilitating Agile ceremonies

Bilingual (English, Spanish, Portugues)

Financial background

Nice to Haves:

Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe Scrum Master, CSM/PSM, or other Agile certifications

Tools & platforms: Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, PowerBI, and collaboration tools like Miro/whiteboarding tools

Technical breadth: Exposure to both cloud and on-prem IT initiatives

Change management experience: Background in organizational change, adoption strategies, or transformation initiatives

Day to Day:

A client of Insight Global is seeking a Project Manager to join their team remotely. This individual will manage 3–4 concurrent enterprise IT projects across data, infrastructure, and application development. Day-to-day, they will drive delivery across Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and hybrid teams, lead standups and stakeholder updates, track budgets and timelines, and ensure scope alignment. They will proactively mitigate risks, enforce accountability, and communicate effectively across global teams in English and Spanish/Portuguese.

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). What does day-to-day look like:

  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs);
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM) $6 - $6/hourpayRequired Skills IMUAttention to DetailVideo CaptureAbout micro1 micro1 is the leading AI data lab for training frontier models and evaluating AI agents. Experts contribute their diverse subject matter knowledge across domains such as finance, healthcare, STEM engineering, and more. micro1 transforms that real-world expertise into high-quality training data, evaluations, and feedback loops that improve how AI systems learn, reason, and perform.

Our platform identifies and vets top talent through an AI recruiter, enabling high-quality expert contributions at scale. We aim to enable 1 billion people to do meaningful work by applying their expertise to AI. As our global expert network grows, micro1 is building the human intelligence layer for frontier AI.

Job Description

Job Title: Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM)

Job Type : Contractor | Remote

Eligible Locations : Mexico, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Jamaica, Bahamas, and Barbados.



About the Role

We’re looking for remote contributors to help support the development of next-generation AI and robotics systems through smartphone-based video and motion data collection.

This is a flexible, paid remote opportunity where you’ll record simple real-world activities using your smartphone while following clear recording guidelines.

No advanced technical background is required, but attention to detail and consistency are important.


What You’ll Do

  • Record short videos of physical activities using your smartphone
  • Capture synchronized motion and video data during recording sessions
  • Follow simple step-by-step recording instructions and quality guidelines
  • Submit a minimum of 10 hours of approved video data per week
  • Communicate with the team regarding recording quality or task instructions
  • Complete a quick onboarding and device compatibility check

Requirements

  • Access to a compatible smartphone:
  • iPhone 11 or newer
  • Google Pixel 6 or newer
  • Samsung Galaxy S21 or newer
  • Ability to use a smartphone head strap for hands-free recording within 48 hours of onboarding
  • Comfortable performing repetitive movement-based recording tasks
  • Reliable internet connection and communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured instructions
  • Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.


Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.


Equipment Requirements

Mobile:

Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.


Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

  • Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices.
  • Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations.
  • Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date.
  • Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration.
  • Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture.
  • Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively.
  • Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection.
  • Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines.
  • Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling.
  • Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications.



Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.


Equipment Requirements

Mobile:

Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.


Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

title: \"Consultor SAP PP / PPDS Sênior # 1007834\"
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Consultor SAP PP / PPDS Sênior # 1007834\" em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dexian é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a Dexian atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


Detalhes do projeto

Atuará em ambientes de alta complexidade e que tenha habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as diretrizes de um template global e as necessidades específicas da operação local. O grande desafio será conduzir a mudança de uma cultura organizacional acostumada com um ECC altamente customizado para a padronização e eficiência do S/4HANA, garantindo a conformidade com a Localização Brasil e as atualizações da Reforma Tributária.

Implantação e projeto de 10 meses (mínimo).


Atividades que irá exercer

Atuar ativamente no Rollout do template global S/4HANA, garantindo a aderência dos processos de planejamento e execução da produção (PP/PPDS):

· Realizar o mapeamento de processos (AS-IS/TO-BE) e identificar Gaps entre a operação atual (ECC customizado) e o novo padrão global.

· Configurar e parametrizar os módulos SAP PP e PPDS, focando em otimização de capacidade e sequenciamento fino.

· Liderar discussões técnicas e funcionais com times globais em Inglês, defendendo as necessidades de localização sem ferir a integridade do template.

· Garantir que os requisitos de Localização Brasil e os impactos da Reforma Tributária estejam refletidos nos processos de manufatura e suprimentos.

· Apoiar a estratégia de migração de dados e testes integrados (SIT/UAT).

· Atuar como agente de mudança, auxiliando os usuários na transição para os novos processos standard do S/4HANA.


Requisitos

Domínio técnico e funcional em SAP PPDS (Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling) :

· Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação ou rollout para S/4HANA.

· Conhecimento profundo em processos de manufatura (MTS, MTO, Process, Discrete).

· Experiência prévia com Localização Brasil (Impostos, NFe integrada à produção, etc.).

· Habilidade de negociação para lidar com stakeholders de diferentes países e culturas.

Conhecimento prévio ou estudos sobre os impactos da Reforma Tributária no ecossistema SAP .

· Certificação oficial SAP S/4HANA (PP ou PPDS).

· Experiência em projetos de grande escala em landscapes globais e integrados.

· Conhecimento em outros módulos integrados (MM, QM ou SD).

IMPRESCINDÍVEL Inglês Avançado para conversação.


Onde vc vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

IMPORTANTE - Ter disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas a Belo Horizonte-MG.

Flexível.

title: Analista SAP Master Data Pleno (MM)
description:

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Você atuará em nosso cliente, uma empresa consolidada, com forte atuação na área de controladoria e processos financeiros, oferecendo um ambiente estruturado, colaborativo e com foco em qualidade de dados e governança.

A ConCrédito é uma das empresas que mais crescem no mercado de crédito consignado e soluções financeiras digitais no Brasil. Atuamos com crédito consignado para CLT, INSS, SIAPE e antecipação do FGTS, oferecendo uma experiência simples, segura e totalmente digital aos nossos clientes. Vivemos um momento estratégico de expansão e evolução tecnológica, com forte investimento em dados, automação, inteligência operacional e experiência do cliente.


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em CRM com experiência comprovada em jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala para liderar a evolução da nossa operação de CRM. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da estratégia de relacionamento da empresa, conectando dados, automações, segmentações e comunicação para aumentar conversão, retenção, engajamento e eficiência operacional. Mais do que operar campanhas, buscamos alguém capaz de estruturar processos, definir boas práticas, construir governança e criar uma operação escalável de CRM orientada por dados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada com CRM e jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala.
  • Experiência com segmentação, automação, testes, monitoramento e otimização de campanhas.
  • Vivência na implementação ou estruturação de ferramentas de CRM, Marketing Automation ou Customer Engagement.
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com integrações, APIs, webhooks e automações.
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas da WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API.
  • Experiência em desenho de jornadas orientadas ao ciclo de vida do cliente.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de CRM, experimentação e mensuração de resultados.
  • Capacidade de atuar com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Conhecimento sobre LGPD, consentimento e governança de dados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar e implementar boas práticas de CRM durante a evolução da plataforma.
  • Desenhar, implementar e otimizar jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala.
  • Criar estratégias de aquisição, ativação, nutrição, conversão, retenção, reengajamento e pós-venda.
  • Transformar objetivos de negócio em segmentações, gatilhos, regras de elegibilidade, réguas de comunicação e indicadores.
  • Definir e organizar a estrutura de dados necessária para suportar as jornadas.
  • Construir segmentações e audiências utilizando dados do Snowflake.
  • Integrar dados, automações e canais por meio do N8N, WhatsApp Cloud API e ColmeIA.cx.
  • Definir padrões para templates, personalização, frequência de comunicação, testes A/B e governança dos disparos.
  • Garantir boas práticas de entregabilidade e escalabilidade no WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver dashboards, funis e rotinas de acompanhamento de performance.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Dados, Tecnologia, Growth, Comercial e Operações.
  • Documentar processos, aprendizados, playbooks e padrões operacionais.


Indicadores sob sua responsabilidade:

  • Taxas de entrega, leitura, clique, resposta e conversão.
  • Taxa de reativação de clientes.
  • Taxa de opt-out, bloqueios e denúncias.
  • Qualidade da conta e saúde do canal WhatsApp.
  • Conversão por jornada, público, produto e etapa do funil.
  • Receita gerada pelas ações de CRM.
  • ROI das campanhas.
  • Eficiência operacional das automações.
  • Qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados utilizados.
  • Resultados de testes A/B e iniciativas de otimização.


O que esperamos que você seja capaz de entregar nos primeiros 90 dias:

  • Diagnóstico completo da operação atual de CRM.
  • Mapeamento das principais jornadas de WhatsApp.
  • Estruturação das boas práticas de governança e comunicação.
  • Definição do modelo de segmentação e gestão de dados.
  • Implementação de dashboards e rotinas de acompanhamento.
  • Criação de backlog de melhorias, hipóteses e automações prioritárias.


Desafio :

Você será responsável por desenhar e evoluir jornadas completas de relacionamento utilizando o WhatsApp como principal canal de comunicação, atuando desde a definição da estratégia até a implementação, análise de resultados e otimização contínua. Também participará diretamente da implementação e amadurecimento da nossa estrutura de CRM, ajudando a transformar dados e oportunidades de negócio em jornadas automatizadas e mensuráveis.


Stack Atual

Você atuará em um ambiente moderno, com foco em dados e automação:

  • Snowflake para Data Warehouse e segmentações
  • Metabase para análises e acompanhamento de indicadores
  • N8N para integrações e automações
  • WhatsApp Cloud API para comunicação oficial
  • ColmeIA.cx para automação multicanal e gestão de jornadas


Perfil que buscamos:

  • Perfil hands-on e orientado à execução.
  • Forte capacidade analítica.
  • Organização e visão de processos.
  • Senso de dono e autonomia.
  • Capacidade de construir estruturas do zero.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes áreas.
  • Visão crítica para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Mentalidade orientada a dados e resultados. 


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Snowflake, Metabase, N8N, WhatsApp Cloud API ou ColmeIA.cx.
  • Experiência em fintechs, crédito consignado, antecipação de FGTS ou serviços financeiros.

  • Experiência com IA aplicada à comunicação e atendimento.

  • Vivência com Growth, Dados, Produto, CX, Vendas ou Operações.

O que você vai encontrar na concrédito:

title: English Teacher
description:

Company Overview


Most English schools in Brazil sell the same thing: promises. Promises of fluency. Promises of confidence. Promises of transformation. And most of them fail to deliver. Not because their teachers aren't capable, but because their model was never built around results in the first place.


AM Consultoria de Inglês was built differently.


We work exclusively with adult learners, using a communicative approach that prioritises real speaking ability. We measure what actually matters: whether our students can use English to do something meaningful with their lives. Every class, every follow-up, every piece of feedback we give is designed with that outcome in mind.


We're growing. And we're looking for a teacher who wants to be part of something that takes results seriously.


If you want a place to clock in, teach, and clock out, this isn't it. If you want to build something that genuinely changes people's lives, read on.



Position Details


  • Role: English Language Coach
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Start Date: Immediate


Candidates MUST be available Monday through Thursday, 7–9pm. Weekly team meeting: Mondays at 10am (30 minutes).



What You'll Do


  • Plan and deliver engaging, communicative classes that students actually remember
  • Support students via WhatsApp between sessions. We stay close to our learners
  • Proactively check in with students to understand their needs and keep them on track
  • Pursue your own professional development. We expect it and we support it



Technical Requirements


  • High-quality video and audio setup
  • Fast, stable internet connection



What We Require


  • CELTA, DELTA, or TKT certification (Cambridge)
  • C2 English proficiency
  • Strong command of Communicative Language Teaching methodology
  • Confident use of online teaching platforms and digital tools



What We're Looking For


Beyond qualifications, we're looking for someone who:


  • Brings genuine energy to every class, Not performance, real presence
  • Is ambitious and wants to grow, with potential to take on leadership responsibility
  • Receives feedback well and actively uses it to improve
  • Communicates proactively and takes ownership of their students' progress
  • Is humble enough to keep learning, no matter their level of experience
  • Has lived, worked, or studied in an English-speaking environment (a strong advantage)



Why AM Consultoria


  • Above-average compensation compared to the broader ESL market in Brazil
  • A methodology that actually works, and that you'll be proud to deliver
  • Adult learners who are motivated, goal-driven, and serious about progress
  • Real input into how we develop and improve our product
  • A small, high-performance team that holds each other to a high standard
  • Room to grow into more than a teacher



We'll be sharing more about our vision, mission, and approach via the link below. If what you've read here resonates — we'd like to hear from you.


Apply now.

SearchTides is a digital marketing agency that specializes in search engine optimization (SEO) and Link Building. We provide services related to SEO including but not limited to the delivery of \"Backlinks\" to its clients.


Role Overview

SearchTides is seeking a talented and versatile Content Writer & Editor who excels at creating and refining engaging, AI-assisted articles that naturally incorporate client backlinks.

In this hybrid role, you will both write original content and edit articles created by other team members, ensuring all content meets our high-quality standards while seamlessly integrating backlinks. This is a comprehensive writing and editing position.

We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry.

Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

About Solvace

Solvace is a fast-growing SaaS platform allowing manufacturing organizations to digitize their Operational Excellence activities, leading to both higher efficiency and effectiveness to create deep impact on their business. Our all-in-one digital OpEx platform contributes to breaking silos while integrating all functions and empowering people across industrial sites.

We integrate with any company’s ERP/MES and connect their data, processes and people (from front-line workers to management levels) leading to better decision making, boosted results, and improvement of local/global communities’ collaboration. We are using a revolutionary software in the Industry 4.0 context with innovative functionalities, new technologies as AR, VR, IoT and AI.

Our 70,000 users represent a large range of industries across the globe. Find out more at:

As an Account Manager – Customer Success , you’ll be the strategic partner for our clients. You’ll guide them through onboarding, adoption, and ongoing optimization of our platform, ensuring they realize the full potential of our technology to support the clients’ Operational Excellence journeys. Your focus will be on retention, satisfaction, and growth—building relationships that last.

You will be part of a passionate team of 60+ professionals and you will report to the Account Director.

Location & type: remote full-time job, located preferrably in Brazil.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients
  • Understand each client’s operational goals, challenges, and KPIs to best match our solutions accordingly
  • Drive successful onboarding and ensure smooth implementation in complex manufacturing environments
  • Build and manage plan to improve key indicators (SLA, NPS, ...)
  • Monitor usage and performance metrics to proactively identify opportunities for improvement
  • Conduct regular business reviews to assess value delivery and align on strategic goals
  • Identify and execute upsell / cross sell opportunities that enhance client outcomes
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and advocate for client needs
  • Provide consultative guidance on best use of the platform to support Operational Excellence approaches
  • Maintain accurate records of account activity, renewal timelines, and client feedback in CRM systems
  • Monitor the Invoice process, including renewals

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in account management or customer success, preferably in SaaS or manufacturing tech
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes, systems (e.g., ERP, MES), and operational challenges
  • Knowledge in Operational Excellence Methodologies – TPM, WCM, Six Sigma,…
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels from shop floor to C-level
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving and client engagement
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and data analytics platforms
  • Ability to work with teams of diverse cultures
  • Fluent in Portugues, English with Spanish as a plus
  • Excellent writing, communication, presentation and management skills

We Expect that you will:

  • - Collaborate in a dynamic, flexible, creative, and open environment.
  • - Enjoy exploring new approaches and technologies.
  • - Communicate clearly and objectively in an agile team.
  • - Embrace learning from mistakes and reporting them – growth mindset.
  • - Go the extra mile! Exceed client expectations and share experiences and ideas with the team.
  • - Work remote with possibility to travel – willingness to go see the customer – expect 50% travel

If you're passionate about driving customer success in a cutting-edge SaaS environment, we invite you to join our 60+ professional team at Solvace. Apply by submitting your application here.

title: Digital Marketing Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Marketing Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SPOKEN ENGLISH IS A MUST!

*Please make sure to submit your resume in English; it will not be accepted otherwise. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Digital Marketing Director

Location: Remote


About Us:

Smart Age Solutions is a leading digital marketing and technology agency specializing in the jewelry industry. We help some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands grow through cutting-edge digital strategies, including SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Email Marketing, Web Development, Conversion Optimization, AI-driven marketing solutions, and eCommerce.


With team members across the United States and Latin America, we combine deep industry expertise with innovation, data, and technology to deliver measurable growth for our clients.


As we continue to scale, we are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing organization, oversee department leadership, and help shape the future of our agency.



Role Overview

The Digital Marketing Director will serve as a senior leader within the company, responsible for overseeing the performance, strategy, and development of multiple marketing departments.

This role is not responsible for executing campaigns directly. Instead, the Marketing Director will lead and develop department managers across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Design, Copywriting, Content, and Marketing Operations while ensuring alignment, accountability, operational efficiency, and client success.


The ideal candidate is a proven marketing leader with agency experience, strong business acumen, exceptional people management skills, and a deep understanding of modern digital marketing strategies, analytics, automation, AI, and performance marketing.

This individual will play a critical role in scaling Smart Age Solutions while maintaining the quality, innovation, and results that define our brand.



Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's overall marketing vision and departmental strategy.
  • Align marketing initiatives with company growth objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and client success metrics.
  • Establish department-wide KPIs, accountability systems, and performance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and profitability.


Department Leadership

  • Manage and mentor department managers across:
  • SEO
  • Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic)
  • Social Media
  • Design & Creative
  • Copywriting & Content
  • Marketing Operations
  • Create clear growth paths, coaching programs, and professional development plans for leaders and team members.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.


Performance & Analytics

  • Establish and monitor KPIs across all service lines.
  • Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Drive data-informed decision-making throughout the organization.
  • Ensure departments are delivering measurable results for clients.
  • Oversee reporting frameworks, dashboards, forecasting, and performance reviews.


Client Strategy & Growth

  • Partner with Account Management and Executive Leadership to support high-level client strategy.
  • Participate in key client meetings and executive reviews when strategic leadership is required.
  • Help identify opportunities for account growth, retention, and improved client outcomes.
  • Ensure marketing strategies align with client business goals and industry best practices.


Innovation & Technology

  • Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging marketing technologies.
  • Evaluate new platforms, tools, and technologies that improve efficiency and results.
  • Drive innovation initiatives across departments.
  • Help position our company as a leader in digital marketing within the jewelry industry.


Operational Excellence

  • Improve workflows, processes, SOPs, and cross-department collaboration.
  • Ensure departments are properly staffed, resourced, and structured for growth.
  • Work closely with executive leadership to forecast hiring needs and organizational development.
  • Assist in building scalable systems that support the company's long-term growth strategy.


Financial Management

  • Monitor departmental performance against revenue and profitability goals.
  • Assist with resource allocation, budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning.
  • Ensure efficient utilization of team resources while maintaining service quality.



Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent English, written and verbal communication skills.
  • 8+ years of digital marketing experience.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Proven success leading teams across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Content, and Creative.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing, analytics, attribution, conversion optimization, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Experience working within a digital marketing agency environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, scale, and optimize high-performing teams.
  • Strong business, operational, and financial acumen.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
  • Experience managing KPIs, forecasting, reporting, and strategic planning.


Preferred

  • Experience in eCommerce, luxury, retail, or jewelry industries.
  • Experience implementing AI and automation solutions within marketing operations.
  • Experience with platforms such as:
  • Google Analytics 4
  • Google Ads
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • HubSpot
  • Shopify
  • Looker Studio
  • SEMrush
  • Whatagraph
  • Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Jira, or similar project management platforms
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Building high-performing department leaders.
  • Improving efficiency and collaboration across teams.
  • Driving measurable improvements in client performance and retention.
  • Scaling processes, systems, and team structures.
  • Introducing innovation and AI-driven solutions.
  • Helping the company continue its growth as a leading digital marketing agency.



Why Join Our Team?

  • Work with some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands in North America.
  • Lead a talented and growing team of digital marketing professionals.
  • Opportunity to shape the future direction of a rapidly growing agency.
  • Collaborative, entrepreneurial, and innovation-driven culture.
  • Remote-first work environment with global collaboration.


We believe exceptional talent comes from diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all qualified candidates are welcomed and encouraged to apply.

We're excited to learn about your experience, leadership style, and vision for building world-class marketing teams.


*Candidates are expected to dress professionally throughout all stages of the interview process.

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

title: Senior Systems Administrator (with AWS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Systems Administrator (with AWS) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About this role

Boldin is hiring a Senior Systems Administrator to own the reliability, security, and performance of the compute, identity, endpoint, and SaaS services our team depends on every day. You will design and operate resilient infrastructure, drive automation, lead complex incidents, and own lifecycle work across a hybrid environment. You will work as a peer to our existing engineer, who will focus on cloud and security engineering.


What you will own

  • Infrastructure and cloud operations. Keep core systems healthy and performant across our cloud and SaaS environment. Run patching, capacity planning, and lifecycle work end to end.
  • Identity and access. Operate SSO, directory, and access lifecycle. Run joiner, mover, and leaver flows. Keep entitlements clean and reviewed.
  • Endpoint and device management. Own the device fleet through MDM.
  • Patching, configuration baselines, compliance posture, and support.
  • Monitoring, incident response, and automation. Tune alerts, run runbooks, lead incidents to root cause, and ship the automation that prevents the next one.
  • Security operations and compliance support. Operate the controls that live in IT: access reviews, endpoint posture, training, and audit evidence.
  • Documentation and continuous improvement. Maintain runbooks, mentor as the team grows, and raise the bar over time.


What you bring

  • Five or more years in a senior systems administration or IT engineering role. You have run an environment, not just executed tickets.
  • Strong cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern OS administration (Linux or macOS at scale; Windows server welcome).
  • Hands-on identity and SSO: directory administration, SAML or OIDC, lifecycle and provisioning.
  • Production MDM experience for at least one major platform.
  • Scripting fluency in at least one of Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Comfort with configuration management or infrastructure as code is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, firewalls) and a SaaS or GRC management platform.
  • Operational ownership of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or comparable compliance controls.
  • Clear writing and good remote judgment. You know when to act and when to escalate.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


Benefits

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Google Security Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Google Security Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga  

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Segurança Google Cloud para atuar em um projeto estratégico global de transformação em cibersegurança, com foco na implementação, arquitetura e evolução do ecossistema de segurança da Google. 

O foco da posição está na construção de arquiteturas seguras, operação de plataformas de detecção e resposta a ameaças, proteção de dados, gestão de postura de segurança e fortalecimento dos controles de identidade e produtividade corporativa. 

Buscamos um profissional que combine forte conhecimento técnico com capacidade consultiva para liderar discussões de arquitetura, apoiar equipes de operação e atuar como referência em segurança Google dentro da organização. 

Responsabilidades  

Atuar como especialista técnico em soluções de segurança Google Cloud, liderando definições arquiteturais e boas práticas de segurança. 

Projetar, implementar e evoluir ambientes de segurança utilizando as soluções nativas do Google Cloud Security. 

Liderar iniciativas relacionadas a monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e operações de segurança utilizando Google SecOps (Chronicle). 

Implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para ambientes Google Cloud, Google Workspace e Chrome Enterprise. 

Desenhar e implementar estratégias de proteção de dados utilizando Google Cloud DLP. 

Atuar na gestão de identidade e acesso utilizando Cloud Identity e controles avançados de IAM. 

Implementar e administrar soluções de Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) e Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP). 

Desenvolver casos de uso, correlações, playbooks e integrações para operações de segurança. 

Conduzir avaliações de postura de segurança, identificação de vulnerabilidades e recomendações de melhorias. 

Participar de projetos de transformação, modernização e fortalecimento da maturidade de segurança corporativa. 

Atuar em conjunto com equipes de infraestrutura, cloud, compliance, governança e operações de segurança. 

  • Inglês fluente para atuação em ambiente global.  
  • Experiência sólida atuando como Especialista, Arquiteto ou Consultor de Segurança Google Cloud.  
  • Experiência prática e hands-on administrando ambientes Google Cloud em produção.  
  • Experiência com Google SecOps (Chronicle), Security Command Center e Google Cloud DLP.  
  • Conhecimento avançado em Cloud Identity, IAM, Google Workspace Security e Chrome Enterprise.  
  • Experiência em projetos de migração de ambientes Microsoft para soluções Google.  
  • Experiência em arquitetura, implementação e evolução de soluções de segurança no ecossistema Google.  
  • Experiência atuando como referência técnica, líder técnico ou principal especialista em projetos de segurança cloud.  
  • Conhecimento em Security Operations, Incident Response e Threat Intelligence.  
  • Experiência com CSPM, CNAPP ou CWPP para proteção de ambientes cloud. 
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders, fornecedores e parceiros de implementação. 
  • Certificação Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.  
  • Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect.  
  • Certificação Google Professional Security Operations Analyst. 

Informações Adicionais:  

  • Atuação 100% remota 
  • Contratação CLT

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Detalhes do projeto

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor ServiceNow nível Pleno com perfil generalista, capaz de atuar de forma transversal em diferentes frentes da plataforma. O profissional será responsável pela evolução contínua e sustentação do ambiente, contribuindo com melhorias técnicas e funcionais.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e melhoria contínua da plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Trabalhar de forma transversal em módulos como ITSM, CMDB e SPM;
  • Desenvolver soluções utilizando scripts, automações e integrações;
  • Realizar troubleshooting e correção de incidentes/problemas na plataforma;
  • Apoiar o desenho de soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, documentação e governança.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento na plataforma ServiceNow, incluindo Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Flow Designer e Integrações via REST (e desejável SOAP);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em ITSM, com atuação em Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management e Request Management;
  • Experiência com CMDB (Configuration Management) com Modelagem de classes e atributos de Configuration Items (CIs), Entendimento de relacionamentos e análise de impacto entre serviços
  • Conhecimento em SPM (Strategic Portfolio Management) ou ITBM, incluindo Gestão de portfólio, Projetos e demandas e Experiência com integrações utilizando REST/SOAP e IntegrationHub, Domínio de Flow Designer e boas práticas de desenvolvimento na plataforma.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Certificações ServiceNow (CSA, CAD ou similares)
  • Experiência com governança da plataforma ServiceNow
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos de médio ou grande porte
  • Inglês avançado.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

  • Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps + AWS integrations
  • Analyze and manage infrastructure costs , proactively identifying optimization opportunities
  • Work closely with engineering teams to:

  • Improve deployment processes and operational efficiency
  • Recommend and implement improvements across existing and new pipelines
  • Ensure proper monitoring, observability, and reliability standards before production releases
  • Support release processes (availability during release windows when needed)
  • Build and maintain reusable infrastructure and automation modules
  • Contribute to security best practices within cloud infrastructure
  • Collaborate in a safe Agile environment, participating in sprints and technical discussions


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years supporting a high-availability cloud environment in a DevOps, SRE, or Sysadmin role
  • Strong, hands-on experience with AWS/Azure
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines, particularly:
  • Azure DevOps
  • AWS-native tools or integrations
  • Systems and Infrastructure deployment and management practices


Preferred Experience

  • Extensive, detailed networking skills, including VPC, VPN, TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, or DNS
  • Experience provisioning, deploying, and supporting containers with Helm, Kubernetes (Kops), or Docker
  • Scripting and development experience using Python, Go, or bash with associated source control
  • Hands-on monitoring tool usage, including: AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar tools
  • Experience with relational databases, such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, and document stores, such as MongoDB

title: Quality Assurance Automação
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Quality Assurance Automação em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para profissional especialista em Qualidade de Softwares com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


O QA de Automação é o profissional responsável por estruturar, implementar e sustentar a automação de testes ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade, rastreabilidade e velocidade nas entregas. Sua atuação vai além da execução técnica: ele contribui para a prevenção de defeitos, fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade e aumento da confiança do time nas releases. Esse papel é especialmente relevante em ambientes com entregas contínuas, múltiplas integrações e necessidade de regressão frequente, pois reduz esforço manual, aumenta a previsibilidade e melhora a estabilidade do produto.


Escopo de atuação

O profissional atua na definição da estratégia de testes automatizados, desenho de cenários críticos, implementação de frameworks, integração com pipelines, análise de falhas, manutenção da suíte de regressão e apoio à evolução das práticas de qualidade do time.



Responsabilidades

  • Implementar, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web, APIs e, quando aplicável, fluxos integrados entre sistemas.
  • Participar da análise de requisitos, refinamentos e critérios de aceite, contribuindo com visão preventiva de qualidade desde as etapas iniciais do desenvolvimento.
  • Definir a melhor abordagem de automação para cada contexto, equilibrando cobertura, custo de manutenção, estabilidade e retorno sobre investimento.
  • Integrar a execução dos testes automatizados às pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo feedback rápido e confiável para o time.
  • Estruturar e manter massa de testes, dados de apoio, mocks, stubs e evidências necessárias para execução consistente dos cenários automatizados.
  • Monitorar falhas recorrentes, identificar causas-raiz e atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores e demais QAs na melhoria contínua da qualidade.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade, cobertura, tempo de execução, taxa de falhas e efetividade da automação.
  • Apoiar a definição e evolução de padrões, boas práticas, convenções de código e arquitetura dos frameworks de teste.
  • Contribuir com a estratégia de Shift Left, promovendo testes antecipados, prevenção de defeitos e maior colaboração entre QA, desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Documentar cenários, fluxos automatizados, premissas técnicas e limitações da suíte de testes para facilitar reuso e manutenção.



Competências técnicas esperadas

  • Experiência com automação de testes para API e Web.
  • Conhecimento em C# e/ou Python, com boa base de lógica, estruturação de código e manutenção de automações.
  • Vivência com ferramentas e frameworks como Selenium, Robot Framework, ReqNRoll ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com testes orientados a comportamento, quando aplicável, utilizando BDD para estruturar cenários de negócio.
  • Conhecimento de integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD para execução automatizada de testes.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente com Git.
  • Capacidade de elaborar cenários de teste rastreáveis a requisitos e critérios de aceite.
  • Conhecimento de testes funcionais, regressivos, smoke tests e validação de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de consultas a banco de dados para validação de dados e apoio à investigação de defeitos.
  • Leitura e interpretação de logs, evidências e relatórios de execução.



Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e dashboards, como Grafana.
  • Experiência com testes de contrato, mocks e virtualização de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de qualidade em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com testes de performance, segurança ou resiliência, mesmo que não seja o foco principal da posição.
  • Vivência com containers, ambientes em nuvem ou orquestração de execução de testes.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de qualidade e governança de testes.
